nieuw.titel: Keep enough of your forest bunker in cover
nieuw.tekst: When deploying a bunker with Move Through Cover in a forest, position enough of its models inside to gain cover as it advances through the terrain.
nieuw.waarom: He considers the risk of moving through the forest negligible when the unit has Move Through Cover.

bronnen.citaat: just 50% of the unit to gain the most access to cover

nieuw.titel: Move only the skirmishers that need to reposition
nieuw.tekst: Reposition only the models needed to bring a skirmishing bunker into spell range or move it clear of a charge threat, while maintaining the wizard's line of sight.
nieuw.waarom: He says shooting penalties apply only to the models that moved, so moving part of the unit minimises the impact on the rest.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He moved five models forward to bring his Shaman into range for The Summoning while keeping him inside the unit, protected from shooting and magic missiles.

bronnen.citaat: you don't have to move all of them. You can just move some of them.

extraCitaten.citaat: minimizing the impact to the unit to get into range.

nieuw.titel: Reform into a line to clear shooting lanes
nieuw.tekst: When models in a skirmishing missile unit give its targets cover, consider reforming into a line to improve its shooting lanes.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that seeing enough of an enemy base through the unit becomes difficult with more than about ten skirmishers.
nieuw.voorbeeld: After the Wild Riders killed his Razorgor and reformed, he reformed his Ungor into a line to shoot them.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says the reform must respect each model's movement allowance and makes every model count as moving. He had to roll Move Through Cover for all of them, and his Shaman took a wound.

extraCitaten.citaat: It does mean that all my models have count as moving.

nieuw.titel: Switch Ungor formations to suit the threat
nieuw.tekst: Use Skirmish for Ungor when protection from shooting matters, then reform into Open Order ranks when preparing to withstand an attack.
nieuw.waarom: He values the shooting penalty against skirmishing infantry, while ranks give his Ungor combat resolution and help their leadership through Warband and Horde.
nieuw.voorbeeld: Against Wood Elves he wanted his Ungor in Skirmish at the start, then reformed them into a ranked block towards the end.

bronnen.citaat: why not just put them into this rank because these ranks

extraCitaten.citaat: give them combat resolution again if anything tries to attack them.

nieuw.titel: Use reforms to gain space while retaining objective control
nieuw.tekst: Use reforms to expand or contract a unit's footprint and occupy the space you need. Keep the required proximity to an objective when changing the formation.
nieuw.waarom: He emphasises that gaining space through reforms is a significant part of manoeuvring.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Ungor stayed barely within the six inches needed to control the Herdstone, preserving his Shaman's plus one to cast.

bronnen.citaat: gaining space with reforms is a really big deal

extraCitaten.citaat: contract or expand, take up a lot of space

aanvullingen.toelichting: He again advocates using terrain to hinder an enemy charge by making it take the low die.
